```{r}
 #path roots for  tax table files

taxtab_files <- list.files(
  path = repo_root,
  pattern = "^taxid\\.csv$",
  full.names = T,
  recursive = T
)


# print the count and file paths

cat(sprintf("Found %d taxonomy table files\n", length(seqtab_files)))
    for (f in seqtab_files) {print(f)}
```



```{r}
library(tidyverse)

master_df <- seqtab_files %>% 
  map_dfr(function(current_file) {
    
    study_folder <- dirname(current_file)
    study_id <- basename(study_folder)
    
    # 1. Read sequence count table
    seqtab <- read.csv(current_file, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>% 
      rownames_to_column(var = "sample")
    
    # 2. Reshape count table to long format
    long_df <- seqtab %>% 
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -sample, 
        names_to = "sequence",
        values_to = "count"
      ) %>% 
      filter(count > 0)
    
    # 3. Look for a taxonomy file in this folder
    tax_file <- list.files(
      path = study_folder, 
      pattern = "tax.*\\.(csv|tsv|txt)$", 
      full.names = TRUE,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
    
    # --- IF TAXONOMY FILE IS MISSING ---
    if (length(tax_file) == 0) {
      
      # SKIP folders without tax files:
      return(NULL) 
      
      # DEFAULT: Keeps sequence counts, adds study_id, leaves tax columns empty (NA)
      message(paste("Skipped taxonomy (file missing) for study:", study_id))
      return(long_df %>% mutate(study = study_id))
    }
    
    # --- IF TAXONOMY FILE EXISTS ---
    tax_path <- tax_file[1]
    
    if (grepl("\\.tsv$", tax_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      taxtab <- read.delim(tax_path, check.names = FALSE)
    } else {
      taxtab <- read.csv(tax_path, check.names = FALSE)
    }
    
    colnames(taxtab)[1] <- "sequence"
    
    # Join taxonomy on sequence and tag with study_id
    long_df %>% 
      left_join(taxtab, by = "sequence") %>% 
      mutate(study = study_id)
  })

head(master_df)
```
